Dear Actief Oostkamp team,

I am writing to apply for the warehouse worker position in Oostkamp. I live in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, and have legal permission to work. I have warehouse experience at Katoen Natie, where I worked in a high-volume logistics environment, and I am comfortable with physical work and cold conditions. I have used an electric pallet truck and am eager to learn reach truck operation through your internal training. I am available to start immediately and can work in a 2-shift system. My English is professional, and I am improving my Dutch (B1). I am looking for a stable, long-term role and would be glad to contribute to your logistics team.

Thank you for your consideration.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Actief Oostkamp team,

I am applying for the warehouse worker position at the logistics company in Oostkamp. With hands-on warehouse experience at Katoen Natie and a strong work ethic, I am confident I can contribute to your frozen food distribution operations.

At Katoen Natie, I worked in a high-volume, fast-paced logistics environment, where accuracy and efficiency were essential. I am used to physical work and comfortable in cold conditions. I have experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT) and am keen to take up your offer of internal reach truck training to expand my responsibilities. I understand the importance of quality checks, keeping the warehouse organised, and following safety procedures.

I live in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, and have my own transportation to Oostkamp. I am available to start immediately and can work in a 2-shift system. My English is professional, and I am currently taking Dutch classes to improve further (B1 level). I am looking for a stable, long-term job where I can grow, and the opportunity to move into a permanent contract with additional training appeals to me.

Thank you for considering my application. I would welcome the chance to discuss how I can support your team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
